name: nonApi_recordInviteEmailed
description: Stamps HC.Hasher.InviteEmailedAt = now for the hashers an 'Email invite codes' send reached (E2.F2.S6), so the next send skips anyone invited in the last 7 days. Called by the InviteEmails API endpoint after the emails are handed to ACS — internal, no device auth. Never touches updatedAt (the Hasher triggers fire only on updatedAt / name / photo / removed), so nothing re-syncs. One LOG.GeneralLog row per send (LogSource 'InviteEmail', StrParam1 = kennel id, Data = {admin, sent}). An empty or NULL list is a successful no-op with stamped = 0. Ids that do not parse as GUIDs are dropped silently by TRY_CAST. Since 2026-10-14 (idempotency audit P3; Idempotent writes: sends something, compare-and-set) the API CLAIMS each hasher before sending (@mode 'claim'), gives a failed send's claim back (@mode 'release') and logs the round once (@mode 'log'); @mode NULL keeps the old stamp-all-now call.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel the invites were for; logged only (LOG.GeneralLog.StrParam1, HC.ErrorLog.kennelId). Default NULL.

parameters.name: adminId
parameters.description: The admin who sent them; logged only. Default NULL.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: '|'-separated HC.Hasher ids. claim: the ids to try to claim; release: ONE id; log / NULL: the ids sent to. NULL or '' ⇒ no-op. Default NULL.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: NULL (default) = the pre-2026-10-14 behaviour: stamp every id now and log. 'claim' = compare-and-set WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK): stamp now only where InviteEmailedAt is NULL or older than @recentDays; rowset 1 lists the rows claimed. 'release' = reset ONE id to @previousAt while it still holds @claimedAt. 'log' = one LOG.GeneralLog row for the round, no stamp.

parameters.name: recentDays
parameters.description: claim only: the 'invited lately' window in days. Default 7; the API passes its RecentWindow so the rule lives in one place.

parameters.name: claimedAt
parameters.description: release only: the stamp the claim wrote (rowset 1 claimedAt). The release applies only while the row still holds it. Default NULL.

parameters.name: previousAt
parameters.description: release only: the value the claim replaced (rowset 1 previousAt), restored on release. Default NULL.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row: { Success, ErrorMessage, stamped }. stamped = rows stamped (NULL mode), claimed (claim) or released (release); 0 for 'log' and on failure.

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

columns.name: stamped
columns.description: Rows of HC.Hasher whose InviteEmailedAt was set (0 on a no-op or on failure).

rowsets.name: ClaimedRows
rowsets.description: @mode = 'claim' only (also on an empty list, with no rows): one row per hasher actually claimed. The API sends to these and no others.

columns.name: previousAt
columns.description: InviteEmailedAt before the claim (NULL = never invited); passed back on release.

columns.name: claimedAt
columns.description: The stamp the claim wrote; passed back on release.

sideEffects: NULL mode: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET InviteEmailedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() for every id. claim: the same, only where NULL or older than @recentDays, under UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK. release: InviteEmailedAt = @previousAt for one id still holding @claimedAt. updatedAt is not stamped; trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForHasher does not fire for this column.
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'InviteEmail') in NULL and 'log' modes; none for claim / release.
On any runtime error: rolls back, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>', userId = @adminId, kennelId = @kennelId), returns the envelope with Success 0.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
changes: 1.1.0 (2026-10-14): optional @mode / @recentDays / @claimedAt / @previousAt and rowset 1 (claim only) — claim before send, release on a failed send (idempotency audit P3). NULL mode unchanged, so the live API keeps working until redeployed.
